blogs.title: What 1‑Bit LLMs Are and Why They Matter
blogs.description: Demystify the concept of 1‑bit large language models – from ternary weights to the energy‑parsing gains – and explain how BitNet b1.58 shows that half as many bits can still match full‑precision performance.

blogs.title: From Floating‑Point to Int8: The Compute Revolution Behind BitNet b1.58
blogs.description: Explore the new computation paradigm where matrix multiplications rely on integer addition instead of expensive floating‑point ops, and quantify the savings in latency, memory bandwidth and silicon power.

blogs.title: The New Scaling Law: When 1‑Bit Models Beat 16‑Bit Counterparts
blogs.description: Walk through the paper’s surprising scaling results—how a 3B bit‑net can outperform a 70B FP16 model—and discuss what this means for future LLM design and research.

blogs.title: Practical Tips for Deploying 1‑Bit LLMs on GPUs & Edge Devices
blogs.description: Translate the authors’ findings into hands‑on guidance on running BitNet b1.58 with common libraries (HuggingFace, vLLM, llama.cpp), hardware considerations, and the potential for mobile/edge use.

blogs.title: Long‑Context Language Models Made Easy with BitNet b1.58
blogs.description: Explain how lowering activations to 8 bits (and beyond) opens the door to long‑sequence inference, why KV cache sizes shrink, and what that enables for real‑world applications.

blogs.title: Can You Build Your Own 1‑Bit LLM? A Yolo‑style Roadmap
blogs.description: Lay out a step‑by‑step plan – data prep, training loop, quantization, evaluation – for reimplementing BitNet b1.58 from scratch or fine‑tuning a pre‑trained version.

blogs.title: Why 1‑Bit Mixture-of-Experts Could Be the Future of LLM Scale
blogs.description: "Mixture-of-Experts" meets “tiny weights”: discuss how 1.58‑bit storage reduces inter‑chip communication overhead making MoE architectures more practical at extreme scale.

blogs.title: "Energy Code” — How BitNet b1.58 Saves Energy Like Magic
blogs.description: Break down the arithmetic energy model used in the paper, illustrate the ~70× savings per matrix multiplication, and talk about real world implications for data centers and green AI.

blogs.title: "New Hardware = New Paradigm": Vehicles for One​–Bit LLMs
blogs.description: "Groq LPUs" meets BitNet: outline why industry needs chip designs that support ternary weights and integer‐only GEMMs, and what design principles should guide such hardware.
